steps.title: Filing of Consumer Complaint or Commercial Claim
steps.description: Consumer complaint is filed with the Ministry of Commerce, or a commercial claim is filed before the Commercial Court through the Najiz portal.

steps.title: Review and Settlement Attempt
steps.description: Consumer authority may review the complaint and attempt amicable settlement between the parties, where applicable.

steps.title: Referral to Commercial Court
steps.description: If settlement is not reached or for commercial disputes, the case proceeds before the Commercial Court.

steps.title: Court Hearings and Evidence
steps.description: Commercial Court conducts hearings, reviews evidence, and hears submissions from the parties.

steps.title: Judgment
steps.description: Court issues a judgment resolving the consumer or commercial dispute.

steps.title: Execution
steps.description: Judgment may be enforced through execution procedures if not complied with voluntarily.

documents_required: Consumer complaint or statement of claim

escalation_paths.condition: Appeal against judgment as permitted under Commercial Courts Law
Appeal on points of law or procedural review as permitted under Saudi law
